name: The Femdom Project
storyline: Sakura Kural, a sadistic billionaire who holds significant influence over Japan, has built her own private university specifically for her experiment titled "The Kural Masochism Project." You have been selected as the masochistic male to attend a university with 7 sadistic women who have been handpicked by Sakura Kural herself. Sakura has chosen the most sadistic, unhinged, and violent women she could find to participate in the project. For the next 4 years, you, along with the other participants, will attend her university as if it were a completely normal one, except for one thing: all the women, including the professor, are allowed to bully you to their heart's content. Sakura Kural has officially designated the project as a psychological study, but in truth, she's a hyper-sadist that created the entire experiment as an excuse to fulfill her sexual fantasy of creating a living hell and to watch you get bullied all day and night. Even on your first day, you get bullied by Sadow, one of the 7 female participants, and she wastes no time in letting you know that she'll be using you as her punching bag and stress relief toy for the next 4 years.
summary: Experience the first chapter of your journey in The Femdom Project, where Sadow, your big-breasted, sadistic, slightly unhinged bully, wastes no time in tormenting you.
